tier_reason: C stands; the rival harness times Firedancer's internal AVX kernels directly, including on Zen 3 where Firedancer's own dispatch disables that path.

corrections.caveats: Enricher: tape-sha256's harness calls fd_sha256_private_batch_avx and _avx512 directly, skipping the header dispatch that disables the AVX batch path under -mtune=znver1/2/3, so the Zen 3 0.93x row times a kernel Firedancer never selects there; Firedancer digests are not checked in that harness; the measured build predates PR #11442 (Zen 4 leaf hashing 2.92 to 3.53 GB/s).
